title: Replace vulnerable
notes: esbuild through tsup 9.0.0 in the four package builders.
result: Raised the four builder floors and adopted the verified lock and workspace installation, preserving previous source and generated outputs recoverably. Failed offline attempts remain documented; a separate frozen online install completed without changing policy, integrity or scripts. No package release or deployment; Nuxt critical findings remain a separate task.
evidence: Pinned pnpm 12.9.1 frozen installation selected all 19 workspaces and matched the qualified 1,823-node graph, including only active esbuild 0.28.2 and three exact native artifacts. Original `pnpm --filter ./packages/ui-quality run build`, `pnpm --filter ./packages/test-quality run build`, `pnpm --filter ./packages/db-quality run build` and `pnpm --filter ./packages/eslint-plugin-code-policy run build` commands each exited 0 on the actual checkout. Source, installed metadata, manager state and the existing fixture remained unchanged during builds. Isolated affected gates passed 1,357 tests with three existing database skips; final UI gates passed 531 tests and package/runtime/watch checks passed. The unchanged `baseline-audit --level moderate` policy passed with nine raw advisories, eight existing active exceptions and one below threshold.
